instruction: Open the note titled "Travel Memo" in Apple Notes, then edit it by appending the line "Check hotel booking tonight." to its content.
reference_command:
note_index=$(memo notes | awk '/^[0-9]+\./ { idx=$1; sub(/\./, "", idx); line=$0; sub(/^[0-9]+\. /, "", line); n=split(line, parts, " - "); title=parts[n]; if (title == "Travel Memo") { print idx; exit } }')
if [ -z "$note_index" ]; then
  echo "Note not found: Travel Memo"
  exit 1
fi
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_edit.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Travel Memo

Trip prep
Check hotel booking tonight.
TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_edit.sh
printf '%s\n' "$note_index" | env EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_edit.sh memo notes --edit
